description: Search messages by subject or sender. Use `from` for sender-only searches without body scanning. `body: true` performs the slower content scan; body-matched hits return a bodyPreview snippet.

body.description: Search message body too (slower). Hits matched via the body include a bodyPreview snippet.

cursor.description: Opaque next_cursor from a previous response.

fields.description: Comma-separated JSON field names to include (e.g. id,subject,from). Trims the payload to fewer tokens.

page.description: 1-based page number. Ignored when cursor is set.

preview.description: Include a plain-text bodyPreview of up to N chars on every hit. Uncached hits cost one batched body fetch (slower).

semantic.description: Use embedding-based semantic search (requires prior `mail index`).
